items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So finally, a reporter, an American reporter there said, okay Buck, okay, you know, just like that to get me up

ctx.x: Nobody would help him because they saw everything. So my guitar player broke his guitar over his head and Teddy Buckner was kicking him and the whole band just jumped, when he hit me they jumped right off the stand and grabbed him. Then when they saw I could stand up, they let me get on him. And he and I battled all out into the bathroom, And I was just sitting on his chest, you know, I was trying to kill him.
So finally, a reporter, an American reporter

there said, okay Buck, okay, you know, just like that to get me up which was better than trying to pull me off of him. So I got off the guy and his head was all swollen and he went out and came back. And we all thought he had a gun when he came back because he was all bloodied up. But he didn't have a gun. He had lost his wallet and was trying to find the wallet. (LAUGHTER).
